description:

613 — цены подписок с типом, валютой, ценой без скидки, ценой со скидкой и размером скидки.
statusMessage:
AssertionError: discountedPrice (1490.0) must be < price (777.0) when discountPercent=22.0
assert 1490.0 < 777.0
 +  where 1490.0 = SubscriptionPricesItemModel(subscriptionType=SubscriptionTypeModel(name='PremiumInternal', id=5), currencyCode='RUB', price=777.0, discountedPrice=1490.0, discountPercent=22.0).discountedPrice
 +  and   777.0 = SubscriptionPricesItemModel(subscriptionType=SubscriptionTypeModel(name='PremiumInternal', id=5), currencyCode='RUB', price=777.0, discountedPrice=1490.0, discountPercent=22.0).price
